scope: Isolated emitted native/full Skeuomorph controls at CPU1/4, desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2. Eight-second scripted DOM events exercise real source controllers and press/toggle/spring rendering, active caller holds, queued actions and resume. Actual RAF intervals, long tasks, cold first paint, readiness and CDP traces are recorded. Fonts are prepared before mounting; state is read only at endpoints. Physical input and original-model equivalence are verified separately. All three controls reject audio construction. Measurements exclude route transfer and do not pass final timing gates.

checkoutLineEndings.policy: Measured source hashes bind actual checkout bytes. Only these unchanged UTF-8 files differ from their Git blobs by CRLF to LF normalization. Every new or changed payload must match the Git index exactly before publication.
